messages.author: e32484f448e128cc
messages.subject: Problems after upgrade?
parts:
Hi all,
I am experiencing a weird problem: this morning I ran the inla.upgrade() and now, when I try to run a INLA model I get this weird message:

*** ERROR *** inla_read_data_likelihood: file [/tmp/Rtmp8cAj72/file315d1f54/data.files/file171e769] contains [27195] elements, but element [3] = [1] is void.

Error in log(m$y) : Non-numeric argument to mathematical function
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In min(x, na.rm = na.rm) :
  no non-missing arguments to min; returning Inf
2: In max(x, na.rm = na.rm) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf

[m being the name of the model I was trying to run]

Funny thing is that I successfully ran the same model on my laptop yesterday and even on this computer this morning before I upgraded INLA. 
Has anyone experienced this problem? 

Thanks!
Gianluca
